channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts from message.cengizyilmaz.net. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow enabling admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out from mid-August to mid-November 2026, this feature requires explicit admin setup and supports compliance monitoring.

item.title: MC1457335: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
item.description: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting August 18th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this late...

item.title: MC1303719: Microsoft Entra: Upcoming changes to federatedTokenValidationPolicy default settings
item.description: Microsoft Entra will update federatedTokenValidationPolicy by mid-August 2026 to block federated sign-ins when internalDomainFederation doesn't match the user's UPN domain, enhancing security. This affects federated domains configured before December 2025. Admins can customize the policy via Microsoft Graph but it's discouraged.

item.title: RM472030: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
item.description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM481834: Microsoft 365: Long-term retention period for M365 Backup
item.description: This creates the ability to set longer term retention periods to restore beyond one year.

item.title: RM501201: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot chat summary
item.description: Missed many messages? Copilot will automatically generate a summary of the new messages in a chat conversation, so you can catch up quickly without reading every message.

item.title: RM543713: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

item.title: RM553224: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
item.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. Updated August 18, 2026: Rollout timing of this feature is now planned for end of August through early September. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM561330: Microsoft 365: Introducing Exchange Online Cross-tenant Message Recall
item.description: We're enhancing the Exchange Online Message Recall feature to add support for cross-tenant recalls. Today, you can recall messages only within your organization. Cross-tenant recall will let you recall messages sent to other organizations that add your tenant to their recall allow list.

item.title: RM564608: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
item.description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

item.title: RM565221: Microsoft Teams: Assistant field visibility in Organization view
item.description: Teams now displays assistant information in the Organization view on the profile card and in the Org Explorer, making it easier to identify a key support contact for executive coordination and scheduling. This designation is informational only and does not grant permissions, change roles, or affect organizational hierarchy.

item.title: RM566316: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

item.title: RM566703: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

item.title: RM567304: Microsoft Teams: Explicit recording and transcription consent for PSTN participants now available in GCC High and DoD
item.description: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments. This feature is already available in Public and GCC clouds and is now being extended to sovereign environments. After this rollout, when a meeting is being recorded or transcribed, PSTN participants will be prompted to provide explicit consent before they can unmute and participate. If consent is not provided, participants will remain mu...

item.title: RM567314: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint app in Teams
item.description: When a user who has access to the SharePoint app in Teams clicks a SharePoint page or news link in Teams chat or channels, the link will open inside the SharePoint app in Teams (if available) instead of the mobile browser

item.title: RM567320: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot admin configuration assistance
item.description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability. Only available for Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.

item.title: RM567461: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you can move faster with less friction.

item.title: RM569205: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Users are now able to temporarily pause all notifications.

item.title: RM569207: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM569212: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher age...

item.title: RM569421: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
item.description: Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.

item.title: RM569425: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
item.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue t...

item.title: MC1457230: Microsoft Outlook: Drag and drop calendar events to reschedule meetings
item.description: Microsoft Outlook will support drag-and-drop rescheduling of calendar events in day and multi-day views starting late August 2026. Users can move only their own events directly on the calendar without admin setup. No action is required, but notifying users and updating training is recommended.

item.title: MC1457229: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Import Executive Assistant data with People connectors
item.description: Microsoft 365 People connectors now ingest Executive Assistant data from external HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors and Workday into Microsoft 365 profiles. This data appears across Microsoft 365 experiences, including Copilot, aiding contact identification. Admins manage data ingestion and source precedence; no user action is required.

item.title: MC1457226: Microsoft OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive for the web will update its file browsing to match the modern SharePoint experience, featuring improved navigation and enhanced filtering across views. This rollout begins mid-August 2026, is enabled by default, and requires no user action but recommends updating training and support materials.

item.title: MC1413302: Discussion post previews coming to Viva Engage
item.description: Viva Engage will add discussion post previews by late August to early September 2026, allowing users to review formatting and presentation before publishing. The feature is automatic, requires no admin setup, and affects all Viva Engage users. Organizations should inform users and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1450134: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors
item.description: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting October 2026, allowing users to meet MFA requirements without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and MFA registration guidance accordingly.

item.title: MC1440972: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Microsoft Edge's upgraded Copilot new tab page integrates Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, web search, and work content into one experience with enhanced chat, compose features, suggested actions, and work cards. It rolls out from early to mid-September 2026, is off by default, and requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

item.title: MC1402306: Microsoft Teams: Use multiple phone lines on Teams mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams Phone will support managing multiple phone lines on the Teams mobile app starting late July 2026, completing by August end. Users can select lines for calls, return calls by line, and view unified call history. No action is required; admins may manage numbers post-rollout.

item.title: MC1387521: Microsoft Teams: Human interpreter listening mode supported in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with Teams Rooms Pro will support human interpreter listening mode starting July 2026, allowing participants to select and switch interpretation languages during meetings. The feature enhances multilingual collaboration, requires organizer enablement, and involves no admin action.

item.title: MC1454234: Power Platform – New Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) announcement
item.description: We are announcing Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) rollout for user sign-in flows to Dataverse as part of ongoing security enhancements for Power Platform. This change affects interactive user access to Dataverse and relies on Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies for near real-time session evaluation. This rollout will begin on August 17, 2026, starting with early release environments in GCC. We will progressively expand to the remaining sovereign environments - including GCC, GCC High,...

item.title: MC1184994: Microsoft Teams frontline BYOD onboarding wizard
item.description: Microsoft planned a dynamic onboarding wizard for frontline workers using personal devices with Teams, supporting MFA and security policies. However, as of August 18, 2026, this change will not proceed. Organizations should review related admin documentation and prepare accordingly. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1420897: Viva Glint: Copilot-enhanced topic assignment for employee feedback comments
item.description: Microsoft Viva Glint will launch Copilot-enhanced topic assignment for employee feedback in late August 2026, adding five new topics. Controlled by the existing VFAM toggle, it improves feedback categorization accuracy and applies initially to ad-hoc and recurring surveys. Organizations should review governance and update processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1454996: Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now pop out into a separate floating window, allowing easier multitasking. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026. Users can resize, reposition, return, or close the chat window with no action required from organizations.

item.title: MC1454381: Microsoft Viva Learning: AI Skills Navigator content available in Learning Agent
item.description: Microsoft Viva Learning integrates AI Skills Navigator content into Learning Agent, enabling users to find curated AI and Copilot training via natural language queries. Available worldwide from mid-August 2026, it offers courses, videos, and credentials by default, requiring no action but recommending admin awareness.

item.title: MC999442: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Retention based on “last accessed” for OneDrive and SharePoint files
item.description: Microsoft Purview will soon allow admins to apply retention policies based on the "last accessed" date for OneDrive and SharePoint files, starting preview in October 2026 and general availability by January 2027. This helps delete obsolete data and improves Microsoft 365 Copilot responses. No admin action is needed before rollout.

item.title: MC1309746: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android) for licensed users, enabling AI-generated summaries and Q&A on notes. Rollout begins end of August 2026, completing by mid-September, with existing Copilot policies applying and no admin action required.

item.title: MC1307979: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) will add a new Copilot chat pane with a Summary feature in OneNote Mobile for iPhone, enabling users to generate summaries and ask questions about notes. Rollout starts late August 2026, completing by mid-September, with existing Copilot policies applying.

item.title: MC1409042: Microsoft OneNote: Copilot notebook available in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, a new AI-powered workspace in OneNote on Mac, will roll out worldwide from late August to early September 2026 for users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. It enables organizing and analyzing notes with generative AI, is enabled by default, and requires no admin action.

item.title: MC1456408: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Planning group support in Adherence historical analytics
item.description: We are announcing planning group support in Adherence historical analytics in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on August 31, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables workforce managers to scope historical analysis to the groups that matter for a given question and compare adherence across groups on the same time period. To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Manage...

item.title: MC1456781: Public preview: Manage agents across multiple tenants from the Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: Multi-tenant agent management is in public preview, allowing partners and enterprise admins to view and manage agents across connected tenants from the Microsoft 365 admin center. It requires GDAP authorization, no extra licenses for management, and Microsoft Agent 365 licenses for viewing agent risk and activity.

item.title: MC1456780: Plan for Change: New device page experience will become the default view
item.description: The new Intune single device page, offering a consolidated device management view, will become the default in the September (2609) release, replacing the legacy page. All management features remain, but admins should update documentation and familiarize themselves with the new interface beforehand.

item.title: RM394279: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Decoupling of Policy tips and Email notifications while configuring rules on Data Loss Prevention for Sharepoint and Onedrive
item.description: As of today, whenever the user wants to enable email notifications the policy tips also need to be enabled and vice versa, but with this decoupling the admin can configure the following: 1) None of policy tips or email notification 2) Only policy tips 3) Only Email Notifications 4) Both Email Notifications and Policy tips

item.description: After further review, we are not able to continue rolling this out at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Engage with agents as a group or privately, with zero state prompts and history support for seamless interactions. item.title: RM557190: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Quarantine Action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
item.description: File Quarantine action in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive, enables stronger, immediate protection for sensitive data. When a DLP policy is triggered, the File Quarantine action automatically moves the file to a restricted, admin‑controlled & defined quarantine location—instantly removing access for all users while preserving the file for review and investigation. This capability helps organizations contain data‑exposure risks, prevents further sharing or misuse, and delivers a...

item.title: RM557563: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
item.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

item.title: RM557684: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
item.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

item.title: RM558860: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
item.description: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.

item.title: RM561321: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint thumbnail previews
item.description: Microsoft Teams on desktop now shows rich link previews when you share SharePoint pages. Links automatically expand into a visually appealing card with a thumbnail image and page description, making it easier to understand and engage with shared SharePoint content directly in Teams.

item.title: RM562662: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
item.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

item.title: RM564805: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Data – Granular access policy controls for custom attributes
item.description: We are introducing enhanced access policy management for Organizational Data in Microsoft 365. This update enables admins to release custom attributes to specific users or groups, rather than broadly to all employees or all managers. This provides a more conservative default approach for managing sensitive organizational data, while also supporting staged rollout of new attributes. Additionally, admins can configure whether leaders and managers are permitted to share non-public data with Workfor...

item.title: RM565373: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
item.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

item.title: RM566315: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
item.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options.

item.title: RM567305: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in Teams meetings and events
item.description: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event. Users defined here will have access to the controls in 'Manage What Attendees See' and the ‘Green Room'.

item.title: RM569215: OneDrive: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
item.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

item.title: RM569363: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

item.title: RM569364: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source
item.description: eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.

item.title: RM569426: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
item.description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user. Private tasks cannot be shared or assigned to others, and existing tasks continue to work and appear alongside them.

item.title: RM569431: Outlook: Change the organizer of a meeting
item.description: Transfer ownership of a meeting or recurring meeting series to another person in your organization. The new organizer must accept the transfer before it is completed. This helps maintain continuity for long-running meetings while preserving the existing event for attendees. Available in Outlook for Windows and web and Teams calendar.

item.title: RM93268: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports
item.description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis. Note: The status and release month has been updated to reflect the current state. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

item.title: RM93269: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports (U.S. Government clouds)
item.description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis.

item.title: MC1255406: Microsoft Purview | Data Security Triage Agent Summaries for DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces AI-generated summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts within Microsoft Defender XDR, aiding security analysts in triage. The Data Security Triage Agent can be deployed from Defender XDR, with management in Purview. Rollout starts April 2026 (preview) and August 2027 (GA). Existing policies remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move files without stopping sync. This update, rolling out mid-September to mid-October 2026, requires no admin action and aims to reduce support tickets and user confusion.

item.title: MC1456610: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Updated commercial Copilot endpoint for Microsoft Edge
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Microsoft Edge will change its endpoint to cr.m365copilotapp.svc.cloud.microsoft by late September 2026. Organizations managing network allowlists or blocklists must update configurations to maintain access. No changes affect those not managing endpoint restrictions. Review and update settings accordingly.

item.title: MC1456609: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection introduces a new auto-labeling per-policy coverage report to help administrators monitor enforcement progress, review labeled and pending files, and identify issues. Available after simulation runs, the report is accessible via a "View coverage" option and lasts 30 days. No action is required to enable it.

item.title: MC1309747: Planner is now available in Outlook and Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft Planner is now integrated into Outlook (web and new Windows version) and Microsoft 365 Copilot, allowing users to manage tasks alongside email and calendar. The rollout begins August 2026, is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and respects existing permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1311979: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support digital signage on idle Teams panels starting early August 2026, configurable via the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. This feature works with select third-party providers (Appspace, XOGO) and requires Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Spaces licenses, allowing tenant-wide or device-specific settings.

item.title: MC1330887: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel based desk devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the bookable desk experience on Teams panel-based devices like Logi Dock Flex, enabling users to view and reserve desks directly. Rollout starts early August 2026, requiring a Teams Shared Space license per device. No admin action is needed; users must connect their laptop to book desks.

item.title: MC1324286: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter disabled by default for live captions
item.description: Microsoft Teams will disable the profanity filter by default for live captions starting mid-June 2026, improving caption accuracy and accessibility. Users can enable or disable the filter anytime. No admin action is required, but informing support teams and users is recommended. This applies to all Microsoft 365 tenants using Teams.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable online mode to access Dataverse for canvas apps in Power Apps. This feature will reach general availability on September 15, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, you can now switch your canvas app between offline and online modes. In offline mode, you can access your Dataverse data without waiting for syncs. item.description: We are announcing Dynamics 365 Contact Center certification for Windows 365 virtual PCs in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on August 31, 2026. item.description: We are announcing the ability to transform customer journeys into action with record creation in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys. item.description: We are announcing planning group support in the Forecast scenario in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. item.title: MC1455051: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Detect intraday volume spikes with workforce alerts
item.description: We are announcing the ability to create volume spike alerts and in-app notifications in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on August 31, 2026. How does this affect me? item.title: MC1430542: Microsoft Outlook: Collaborate with Copilot while drafting email
item.description: Microsoft Outlook will integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot into the email compose experience by mid-July 2026, enabling licensed users to create, refine, and edit emails with AI assistance across supported platforms. The feature is enabled by default, with no admin changes required.

item.title: MC1455028: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Planning group support in Adherence tracker
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use planning group support in Adherence tracker in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on August 31, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to filter the Adherence tracker by planning group and combine this filter with existing shift plan and service representative filters. item.title: MC1289726: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Direct Export will support Customer-managed key (CMK) encryption for tenants with Data Encryption Policies via MDEP. Starting public preview in May 2026 and general availability in late 2026, export packages will be automatically encrypted with tenant-owned keys without changing the user experience. Tenants must configure CMK and request enablement from Microsoft Support.

item.title: MC1403407: OneDrive for the web: New libraries browsing experience
item.description: OneDrive for the web will replace the "More places" experience with a new Libraries view by mid-August 2026, improving access to SharePoint libraries via recent activity, Teams, and favorite sites. It includes filtering, sorting, and view options, requires no admin changes, and maintains existing permissions.

item.title: RM464996: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Actionable Email Notifications for Enhanced Incident Remediation
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention end-user email notification is getting advanced incident remediation capabilities: actionable email notifications. This new feature allows end users to take remediation actions directly from their mailbox, streamlining the remediation process. The end users will be able take remediation actions on files on OneDrive and SharePoint that caused a policy match. item.title: RM527831: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Actionable Email Notifications for Enhanced Incident Remediation

This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

item.title: RM565218: Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High and DoD
item.description: We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High and DoD clouds. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium feature. For more information about Queues app, including licensing information, please see Manage Queues app for Microsoft Teams in your organization.

item.title: RM565868: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
item.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

item.title: RM566697: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
item.description: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. Users with edit/annotate rights can add a full set of annotations — including ink, highlight, free text, notes, signatures, image/shape/date stamps, bookmarks, and form fields — directly in the OneDrive mobile PDF viewer; the file's encryption and usage rights are preserved end to...

item.title: RM567465: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for DoD environments
item.description: Shared display mode in Teams is now available in government DOD environments, enabling more seamless and private meeting hosting from your PC. Additionally, peripheral detection for bring-your-own-device spaces is available for inventory management and reporting through the Pro Management portal.

item.title: RM568067: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
item.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

item.title: RM568076: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform Single Sign-on can now be used as a second factor for MFA
item.description: Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) and macOS Platform SSO (macOS PSSO) can now satisfy multifactor authentication as a standalone second factor. Previously, these methods only counted as MFA during primary sign-in, and users needed a separate passkey to complete step-up prompts, Authentication Strength policies, and sign-in frequency checks. item.title: RM569203: OneNote: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (DoD, GCC, GCC High)
item.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for DoD, GCC, and GCC High clouds now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

item.title: RM569208: SharePoint: HTML pages
item.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

item.title: RM569210: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

item.title: RM569211: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

item.title: RM569213: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
item.description: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.

item.title: MC1404322: Microsoft Teams: Recap app consolidates meeting recaps in one place
item.description: The Microsoft Teams Recap app, rolling out July–August 2026, centralizes meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries for improved productivity. It offers filters, audio/video recaps, and access to past 30 days' meetings. AI features require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license; the app is pre-installed but not pinned by default.

item.title: MC1266027: Microsoft Teams: New experience when users minimize the meeting window
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating the minimized meeting window to allow key actions like raising hands and sending reactions without reopening the full window. Users can choose between expanded or compact views. The rollout paused as of July 7, 2026, with no impact on screen sharing or admin settings.

item.title: MC1251206: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots attempting to join meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. This feature rolls out from mid-May to August 2026, with admin policies to manage bot handling enabled by default for all tenants.

item.title: MC1218712: Microsoft Teams: Meeting notes now available for instant meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports meeting notes for instant meetings via Loop components, enabling collaborative agendas, notes, and task creation synced with Planner and To Do. Rollout occurs April–August 2026 across environments. Notes appear in a pane, accessible post-meeting in Recap, with default company shareable links. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1090689: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced peripheral data in Pro Management portal reports for BYOD spaces
item.description: Microsoft Teams' Pro Management portal now offers enhanced peripheral health reports for BYOD rooms and desks, helping admins detect device issues proactively. Room reports need a Teams Shared Devices license; desk reports are in public preview without a license. Rollout starts late June 2026, completing by August.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window to reduce disruptions. This feature will roll out from May 2025 to August 2026 across all platforms, requiring no admin action but user notification is recommended.

item.title: MC1317197: Microsoft Teams: A refreshed in-meeting experience with simpler controls and a smarter share panel
item.description: Microsoft Teams will refresh in-meeting controls and the share panel to reduce mis-clicks and accidental sharing. Updates include center-aligned controls, a separated Leave button, customizable controls, and a two-step share confirmation. Rollout begins July 2026, with no tenant-level disable option and temporary user opt-out.

item.title: MC1266023: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Comprehensive Copilot metrics in Copilot Analytics
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is adding new usage metrics across apps like Copilot app, Edge, OneNote, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, enhancing insights in Copilot Analytics. Rollout begins mid-June 2026, is automatic for licensed users, requires no configuration, and unifies Copilot Chat reporting.

item.title: MC1404319: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint data loss prevention support for FTP and SFTP
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will support monitoring and protecting FTP and SFTP transfers on managed Windows devices, preventing unauthorized data exfiltration. Public preview starts early September 2026, with general availability in October 2026. Admins must enable and configure this feature in policies; no immediate action is required.

item.title: MC1448378: (Update)Microsoft Purview | Endpoint DLP: Prepare for the macOS Golden Gate (version 27) accessibility permission change
item.description: Apple's macOS Golden Gate (version 27) allows users to disable Accessibility permissions despite MDM settings. Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP relies on these permissions for monitoring; without them, Safari, Chrome, and Firefox are restricted, increasing enforcement alerts. Organizations must update configurations, upgrade clients, and monitor device compliance by early September 2026.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Migration to Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy begins September 2026. Check your tenant’s configurations and migrate before EWS shutdown on April 1, 2027, to avoid service disruption.

item.title: MC1266025: Update on custom domain guidance for Teams Event emails
item.description: For worldwide customers, configuring a custom domain is no longer required to use custom HTML editing for Teams Events emails, effective immediately. However, GCC, GCC High, and DoD customers must still configure a custom domain. Custom domains are recommended for better sender identity, deliverability, and trust.

item.title: MC1009930: Microsoft Teams: Distinguish invites among Attendee, Presenter, and Co-organizer emails
item.description: Microsoft Teams will send separate event invites based on participant roles—attendee, presenter, or co-organizer—allowing organizers to manage distinct invites for town halls. Rollout starts mid-October 2026, completing by late November 2026, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1450133: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
item.description: Users can now register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method in Microsoft Entra, eliminating the need to set up weaker methods first. This change, rolling out from October 2026 to February 2027, aims to increase adoption of phishing-resistant authentication without requiring admin action.

item.title: MC1452771: Dynamics 365 Project Operations – Enable project fee journals to support subscription billing
item.description: We are announcing the ability to support subscription billing through project fee journal functionality for production and stocked deployment scenarios in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 11, 2026. How does this affect me? Dynamics 365 Project Operations for manufacturing now supports subscription billing through the project fee journal functionality. This allows organizations to streamline revenue recognition, improve billing accuracy, a...

item.title: MC1452374: Microsoft Exchange Online: Retirement of the Other features page in Exchange admin center
item.description: The Other Features page in the Exchange admin center will be retired between September 2026 and February 2027 to simplify Exchange administration. Its links remain accessible via their own Microsoft admin portals. No Exchange Online functionalities will be removed. Administrators should update related documentation and bookmarks accordingly.

item.title: MC1452372: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection will increase auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day starting September-October 2026. This enables faster, broader content labeling without policy changes, enhancing data protection and compliance monitoring. No action required.

item.title: RM508524: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
item.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

item.description: The Data Security Posture Agent is designed to expand the capacity of data security admins as they proactively work to stay on top of a dynamic data and risk landscape within their organization. item.title: RM557191: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Block External Domain/User action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
item.description: Block External Domain/User action in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive, gives organizations stronger control over who can access sensitive files. With this enhancement, admins can configure DLP policies that block file access for specific external domains or individual users. This capability helps prevent unintended exposure by external users and supports enterprise compliance requirements.

item.title: RM558250: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Simplified Channel Management
item.description: Use device selection criteria in Cloud Update to assign profiles using Microsoft Entra ID groups and streamline the onboarding process. Admins can combine channel and profile assignment in a single step, making it easier to move devices between update channels and maintain consistent update management across the organization.

item.title: RM560339: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Proactive push notifications for the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will proactively send push notifications for common productivity workflows like 'Your Day at a Glance' and 'Items waiting for you', which send users to the respective Copilot response when opened. This feature taps into your Copilot Memory and will be available for users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses and can also be accessed once opening the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

item.title: RM560551: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure data retention policy for Viva Glint
item.description: This feature will introduce the capability for Glint service administrators to configure a data retention policy for their Glint instances based on the organizational policies. Any past survey cycles including engagement surveys, always-on surveys, lifecycle surveys and 360s will be retained/deleted based on this data retention configuration period.

item.title: RM560821: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Export Heat Map report in Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides
item.description: Managers will be able to export the default sections from the Heat Map report in Viva Glint directly to editable PowerPoint slides. This enhancement allows for easier and quicker consumption of this report outside Viva Glint, compared to the previous export method which included static screenshots.

item.title: RM561037: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot can analyze content shared on desktop screen and through mobile camera
item.description: Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps you make faster, more informed decisions by understanding context from what you share on screen or camera. Copilot can analyze visual inputs from shared desktop screens and provide detailed insights about the content. You can also use vision on mobile during a real-time voice session to share your device camera, front or back, and ask questions about what is in front of you. item.title: RM561490: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

item.title: RM561892: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.

item.title: RM562033: Microsoft Purview: Role groups UI enhancements
item.description: The Role groups page in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal now allows admins to look up permissions by roles and memberships.

item.title: RM564910: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Outlook Emails in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Outlook Emails as References in Copilot Notebooks bring email content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot in the conversations, decisions, and context that drive their work.

item.title: RM565028: OneDrive: New Shortcuts folder option when adding shortcuts
item.description: OneDrive makes it easy to add shortcuts to the files and folders you use most. Now you can choose to keep those shortcuts neatly together in one place instead of mixed in with everything else. When you add a shortcut, you can send it to a dedicated "Shortcuts" folder rather than your OneDrive root. The folder is created automatically the first time you use it and is easy to spot, with a distinct color and building icon. The Shortcuts folder behaves like any other folder—move it, rename it, share...

item.title: RM568790: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS.

item.title: RM568793: Microsoft Edge: Updated horizontal tab appearance
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing an updated horizontal tab-strip appearance on Windows and macOS. The treatment uses rounded tabs with revised spacing and aligns related tab-strip controls with the refreshed browser-frame design. Tab behavior and enterprise data handling remain unchanged.

item.title: RM568929: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Dataverse integration on Copilot Studio
item.description: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data. This enhancement allows organizations to leverage business-critical information stored in Dataverse—including records, customer data, operational data, and business application content—as a trusted knowledge source for agent experiences.

item.title: RM569017: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
item.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

item.title: MC1287365: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Change in accessing additional agents in Excel
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel now allows access to additional agents via the "…" menu under M365 Copilot. The update, rolling out worldwide through August 2026, affects all licensed Excel users without changing editing behavior or permissions. No admin action is required; update support and documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1059679: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Policy tuning analysis for priority content only policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will support real-time policy tuning analysis for priority content policies starting late June 2025 (worldwide) and December 2026 (GCC/DoD). Admins can enable Analytics to predict user matches, adjust thresholds, and optimize alerts for insider risk policies scoped to priority content.

item.title: MC1392571: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place instead of multiple plans. This feature, rolling out from late September to October 2026, is enabled by default and supports automated or manual task creation via Facilitator.

item.title: MC1282567: Create charts on pages with AI in SharePoint
item.description: SharePoint will introduce an AI-assisted Charts web part for page authors to create interactive charts using plain-language prompts. Rollout starts late May 2026, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license. The feature is enabled by default, with no action needed from organizations.

item.title: MC1358831: Copilot settings in classic Outlook for Windows
item.description: Copilot settings will be added to classic Outlook for Windows under the File menu, allowing users to manage Copilot directly, including turning it on or off. Rollout begins June 2026 with general availability by August. No changes to licensing or admin controls; no action required.

item.title: MC1311978: Classic Outlook for Windows: User-initiated insights with Copilot
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will add user-initiated Copilot insights, allowing users to highlight email text and get contextual AI-generated explanations. Rolling out from May to September 2026, this feature is on by default for eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot users and integrates directly without extra add-ins.

item.title: MC1450135: Viva Learning: Copilot experience transitions to Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: The Viva Learning Copilot experience is transitioning to Learning Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, providing a unified, personalized learning experience. Rollout occurs from late June to August 2026 for all Viva Learning licensed users. Admins should review access, update materials, and manage deployment via Microsoft 365 controls.

item.title: MC1450131: Microsoft SharePoint: New report on Everyone except external users
item.description: A new SharePoint admin center report launching in August 2026 provides item-level visibility into permissions granted via "Everyone" and "Everyone except external users" groups. It helps administrators identify and remediate overshared content across SharePoint and OneDrive without changing existing permissions.

item.title: MC1450130: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks' multimodal capture—combining audio transcription, image capture, and typed notes—is expanding to OneNote for Android. Available from mid-August 2026, it generates AI-structured pages saved in Copilot Notebooks, requiring Microsoft 365 Copilot and SharePoint or OneDrive licenses. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1450128: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive scopes add lifecycle status evaluation controls for recipients and site owners
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces lifecycle status controls for adaptive scopes, evaluating only active recipients and site owners by default. Administrators can include inactive or soft-deleted users as needed. Support for ISO 8601 durations in queries is added. Rollout begins mid-September 2026, with no immediate action required.

item.title: RM554934: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

item.title: RM566317: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
item.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

item.title: RM566858: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

item.title: RM566871: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Security Mode Plus
item.description: Enhanced Security Mode Plus adds optional, admin-configurable protections on top of Enhanced Security Mode to further reduce browser attack surface. Admins can configure preset or custom modes to restrict selected network protocols and compression behavior, hardware-access web APIs, WebGL, and external protocol launches when Enhanced Security Mode is enabled.

item.title: RM568930: Microsoft Copilot Studio: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio
item.description: The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. item.title: RM568931: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
item.description: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

item.title: RM568933: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
item.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the ca...

item.title: RM568934: OneDrive: Uninstall OneDrive Photos without affecting file sync
item.description: OneDrive is giving people more control over their Windows experience by allowing them to uninstall the OneDrive Photos experience independently. Removing the Photos experience does not uninstall the OneDrive app, interrupt file sync, or delete photos and files. This provides a clear removal option for people who prefer to manage their photos with another app.

item.title: RM568935: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
item.description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation sna...

item.title: RM568936: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
item.description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

item.title: RM569020: OneDrive: Anchored comments in the PDF viewer
item.description: Microsoft is adding anchored comments to the PDF viewer in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. Users can attach a comment to a specific spot on a page, to selected text, and collaborate through replies and @mentions — bringing PDF review to parity with commenting in Office documents. This feature will be on by default and requires no admin action.

item.title: RM569021: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

item.title: RM569022: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
item.description: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

item.title: RM569023: Outlook: Language support for Summarize in Classic Outlook
item.description: When the content language and the Outlook language do not match, you will be able to select a different language to view summarize Copilot responses.

item.title: MC1426714: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize Power BI reports
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights will allow eligible users to create, customize, and save Power BI reports, including adjusting periods, filters, and layouts. Rollout begins early September 2026. Existing security and permissions apply. Admins can control feature access via Viva Feature Access Management. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1420903: Exchange Online will prevent creation of duplicate Dynamic Distribution Groups
item.description: Exchange Online will block creation of exact duplicate Dynamic Distribution Groups starting late July 2026 to improve reliability and reduce redundancy. Existing DDGs remain unaffected. Administrators should update scripts to handle duplicate errors and review current DDGs. No action is needed for most organizations.

item.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

item.title: RM516577: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
item.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

item.title: RM564969: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM568075: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.

item.title: RM568078: Microsoft Teams: Badges in Profile Card in Teams
item.description: You can now see Awards and Certifications as badges on a user’s profile card, bringing a more consistent experience across Teams and Outlook.

item.title: RM568369: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
item.description: Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.

item.title: RM568370: Microsoft 365: [Education] Control access to Learning Activities and Teach
item.description: IT administrators can manage access to Learning Activities and Teach from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Configure Learning Activities separately for educators and for students ages 13 and older and enable or disable Teach for educators to align AI experiences with your organization's policies and deployment readiness.

item.title: RM568762: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
item.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

item.title: RM568789: Outlook: Enhanced user interface updates for iPhone and iPad
item.description: People using Outlook for iOS on iPhone and iPad will see refreshed interface elements aligned with the latest Liquid Glass iOS visual experience, including modernized app chrome, navigation, and use of screen space. It will be enabled by default with no administrator action required.

item.title: MC1449180: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling support for non-Microsoft applications
item.description: Microsoft Purview will support Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling for non-Microsoft applications like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce via Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. Administrators can create and manage policies directly in Purview starting mid-August 2026, expanding compliance and data protection capabilities.

item.title: MC1449174: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Teams live chat retirement
item.description: Microsoft Teams live chat will be retired by mid-October 2026. New setups end August 2026, and support stops October 2026, disabling chat message relay. Organizations must remove the chat widget by October 5, 2026, notify users, and find alternative solutions. Historical chat data remains accessible.

item.title: MC1449170: Microsoft Edge: Retirement of default unload event support
item.description: Microsoft Edge will stop running unload event handlers by default starting September 2026, requiring sites to explicitly permit them via Permissions Policy. Organizations should migrate to modern lifecycle events like visibilitychange and pagehide, update applications, and use provided policies temporarily during transition.

item.title: RM405754: Outlook: Import support for data files in Outlook
item.description: This feature adds support for importing PST files into Outlook for Mac.

item.title: MC1442614: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing IntelliFrame for Teams Rooms on Windows with AI data channels on certified cameras, enabling faster speaker framing, participant recognition, and smoother views. Rolling out worldwide from mid-October to mid-November 2026, this feature is enabled by default and requires no admin action.

item.title: MC1420901: Notebooks in the M365 Copilot App
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce updated Notebooks by late August 2026, integrating chats, content, and references for seamless project organization. Notebooks sync with OneNote without changes to existing data. No admin action is needed; users with a Copilot license will access this feature.

item.title: MC1431377: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: AIR Investigation Experience Improvements
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365's AIR experience will add a manual refresh button, replacing auto-refresh, and simplify investigation names by removing email subjects and UPNs. These changes improve performance, reduce network activity, and support data minimization. No admin action is required, but workflow updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1173208: Microsoft Copilot Analytics: Data export public preview for Copilot metrics in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a default-on, de-identified data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. Available from December 2025 (preview) and September 2026 (general), it enables export of weekly, user-level Copilot usage metrics for analysis and licensing optimization.

item.title: MC1227622: Transitioning Teams Android Device Management from Teams admin Center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026 (public cloud) and August-September 2026 (GCC environments). PMP will unify management for all Teams devices, with TAC device management deprecated by September 2026. Admins should prepare by reviewing updated guidance and updating documentation.

item.description: Update: Release of this feature has been updated. We are announcing the ability to split recordings by speaker in the closed conversation view in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. item.description: We are announcing the ability to classify emails in predefined taxonomy (categories and subcategories) for support automation with Case Management Agent in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This feature will reach general availability on August 21, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enhancement allows administrators to configure a set of custom taxonomies for email categories and subcategories and uses the Case Management Agent to automatically classify inbound emails as they sync into Dyn...

item.title: MC1448669: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Equip voice agents with custom voice
item.description: We are announcing the ability to equip voice agents with custom voice in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will be available in public preview on August 21, 2026. How does this affect me? Users will be able to connect an approved Azure custom neural voice to Dynamics 365 Contact Center and use it for self-service voice channels. item.title: MC1308855: Collect Diagnostics change to Get Diagnostics for Outlook Mobile and Mac
item.description: The Collect Diagnostics feature in Outlook Mobile and Outlook for Mac is renamed to Get Diagnostics, with diagnostic logs now sent to the Microsoft 365 diagnostics service instead of PowerLift. The rollout begins early August 2026, requiring updates to documentation and network allowlists but no user workflow or admin changes.

item.title: MC1387578: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template to users' preferred Outlook languages, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Rollout starts June 2026 worldwide, with no changes to message classification or custom templates. No action required.

item.title: MC1448372: SharePoint Pages: Command bar menu and page state indicator updates
item.description: SharePoint Pages will update the command bar by reordering the +New menu, changing labels (e.g., Save and Close to Save and Exit), and adding a page status indicator showing Draft or Published states. Rollout starts August 2026, affecting site owners/editors only. No admin action required.

item.title: RM502524: Microsoft Teams: New SlimCore-based optimization for Microsoft Teams in VDI - support for MacOS on Citrix and Azure Virtual Desktops/Windows 365
item.description: This feature allows MAC endpoints to optimize Microsoft Teams in VDI environments with the new SlimCore-based media engine, providing an expanded feature set and multiple improvements in quality, reliability and performance.

item.title: RM523205: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use voice for Q&A during Read Aloud in Word
item.description: Interact in real time with read aloud in Word with Copilot. While your document is being read aloud, you can ask questions with your voice—such as “What does this mean?” or “Summarize this section”—and get answers instantly. No need to pause and search manually. This keeps you in context, reduces interruptions, and helps you understand and act faster.

item.title: RM552598: Microsoft Edge: Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
item.description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

item.title: RM553223: Microsoft Teams: Voice tethering
item.description: The voice tethering feature builds on the recent introduction of Sign Language Mode. It ensures that when an interpreter voices for a D/HH signer, captions and transcripts attribute the spoken content to the signer rather than the interpreter. This provides accurate representation in meetings and makes it clear who is contributing to the conversation. item.title: RM555878: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
item.description: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping formatting consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.
