item.description: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping the design consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: RM558853: Microsoft Teams: Entra passwordless resource account support for Teams Rooms on Windows and Android devices
item.description: Teams rooms on Windows and Android, Panels and Teams Phones now supports Entra Resource Accounts for secure, passwordless sign-in that separates device and user identities. IT admins can migrate to Entra accounts easily with the migration wizard, and track progress using a dashboard in the Pro Management portal.

item.title: RM559386: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
item.description: Manage call queues and engage with customers wherever work takes you. The Queues app on Teams mobile enables on the go workers to stay connected and responsive when handling customer calls. Calling representatives and supervisor leads can view assigned queues, opt in or out of a queue's call routing, and review their call history—all from their mobile device. Supervisor leads can also bulk manage queue participation for their teams. With seamless mobile access, the Queues app helps teams respond...

item.title: RM561033: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
item.description: This dashboard will allow admins to view the device health across all their devices to ensure the system is healthy and ready to receive policy updates and quickly identify devices that are not ready.

item.title: RM562035: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter - Simultaneous mode enhancements
item.description: We’re raising the bar on clarity and control with Interpreter. Admins can fully disable voice simulation via PowerShell when needed. Each speaker is automatically assigned a distinct voice, making multi-speaker conversations easier to follow. We’re reducing distractions by showing shimmer effects only to Interpreter users. We’ve added audio notifications to confirm activation, and we’ve introduced in-product feedback mechanisms so users can easily share their input.

item.title: RM562413: Microsoft Teams: Searchable keyboard shortcuts from the dialog in Teams
item.description: Easily find keyboard shortcuts with a new searchable experience in Microsoft Teams. Search by shortcut name or enter part of a key combination directly in the dialog.

item.title: RM564613: Microsoft Teams: New layout when sharing content for Teams events
item.description: Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools will see updated layout options when sharing content in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. The available layouts are "Speaker focused", "Content focused", and "Content only". The new Speaker focused layout prioritizes presenter video alongside shared content for greater visibility. This feature is available for Teams events organizers with a Teams Enterprise license. This feature is available on Teams for Win...

item.title: RM564912: Microsoft Teams: New room optimization mode user experience in Teams desktop
item.description: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. The new room optimization mode replaces shared display mode, has a new location, and enables or disables room-specific features. When room peripherals are connected, Teams can automatically select audio and video devices, enable speaker recognition and shared display, and disable voice isolation.

item.title: RM565870: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

item.title: RM567298: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can access production controls for Teams events
item.description: Organizations can allow external presenters to manage Teams events by granting them access to production controls. Federated (B2B) and guest users can be specified in the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling trusted external presenters to run events and manage what attendees see. This feature supports organizations that work with third-party event producers and vendors.

item.title: RM568761: OneDrive: Improved OneDrive experience in iOS Files app
item.description: OneDrive is updating its integration with the iOS Files app to use Apple's Replicated File Provider API. This update provides end-user improvements such as better upload progress. As part of the change, read-only Shared and Libraries locations will no longer appear in the Files app integration. Users can use Add to OneDrive for shared content and libraries they need to access, including write access where permitted.

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM568782: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

item.title: RM568787: Microsoft Edge: Changes to local IP address detection for proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts
item.description: Microsoft Edge is changing how it selects the local network address reported to proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts and is adding administrator control over it. The default IPv4 and IPv6 probe destinations now match Chromium’s defaults. Administrators can override these defaults using the PacMyIpAddressIPv4ProbeAddress and PacMyIpAddressIPv6ProbeAddress policies when required by their network routing.

item.title: RM568792: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

item.title: MC1441781: Add and upload your custom skills to OneDrive from within PowerPoint Copilot (Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot on Mac now lets users create, upload, and manage personal custom skills directly within the app, storing them in their OneDrive. This feature, rolling out worldwide from late July to mid-August 2026, enhances customization without requiring admin action.

item.title: MC1441782: Upload or add a custom skill with Copilot in PowerPoint (Web)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot users can now upload and create personal custom skills directly within PowerPoint on the web, stored in their OneDrive. This feature, rolling out worldwide from late July to mid-August 2026, enhances customization without requiring admin action but recommends updating governance and support materials.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to auto-assign open shifts based on availability, time off, and scheduling rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to end of August 2026, the feature is optional and allows review before publishing. No action required from users.

item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, completing by August. Presenters keep full control via console, no impact on remote attendees, and no configuration needed. A Teams Rooms Pro license is required.

item.title: MC1310683: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for PowerPoint, Excel, and Word files
item.description: Microsoft Teams will standardize the preview experience for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files by end of August 2026, improving load times and reliability. PowerPoint and Excel previews are on iOS and Android; Word preview is on iOS only. The feature is enabled by default with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. This rollout begins early June 2026, enhancing branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, offering improved streaming reliability and backup with automatic failover alongside existing RTMP. No user impact; admins must enable SRT in meeting policies and update event production accordingly.

item.title: MC1250273: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve copy-paste support for @mentions and shared contacts by preserving interactive tags when valid in the destination. If invalid, tags revert to plain text with original display. Rollout occurs May to August 2026 across platforms, requiring no admin action and enhancing messaging consistency.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal will add building-level insights on the recommended actions page by mid-June to end August 2026. This feature highlights buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and remaining BYOD rooms, helping IT ensure consistent meeting experiences. It is enabled by default for eligible licenses. No action needed.

item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to improve reliability for large live events. If the primary stream fails, Teams automatically switches to the backup without affecting attendees. Rollout starts late April 2026 and completes by August 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1197146: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-June to August 2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1085133: Microsoft Teams: Rule-based enablement of Microsoft 365 third-party apps in the Teams admin center
item.description: Starting mid-April 2026, admins can manage Microsoft 365 certified third-party Teams apps via org-wide settings in the Teams admin center, enabling rule-based app availability control. The rollout is automatic, with the new control disabled by default. No tenant-wide changes occur without admin action.

item.title: MC688109: Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
item.description: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

item.title: MC1446794: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a meeting" feature starting August 2026, allowing users to report suspicious or malicious activity during meetings. Reports help security teams investigate threats via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center. The feature is enabled by default, with administrative controls and data collection for security investigations.

item.title: MC1447673: Microsoft Teams: Users can report security concerns in group calls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a call" feature for group calls, allowing users to report suspicious calls from call history. Administrators can review reports in Teams admin center and Microsoft Defender. The feature rolls out from August to October 2026 and is enabled by default.

item.title: MC1447683: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Scheduled Prompts moves to Microsoft 365 Connected Experiences
item.description: Scheduled Prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot will move from the Optional Connected Experiences policy to Microsoft 365 Connected Experiences by late August 2026. This change affects governance and compliance controls but not user functionality. Administrators should review and update policies accordingly; most organizations need no action.

item.title: MC1447682: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing live captions with a new right-side panel view and a consolidated settings menu for easier configuration. Users can auto-enable captions, submit feedback, and benefit from synchronized translation settings. Rollout begins mid-August 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1447681: Microsoft Viva Engage: Custom branding for tenant-wide visual identity
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage introduces Custom Branding, allowing admins to apply tenant-wide brand name, logos, and theme color via a Brand Center. This overrides individual user themes and Microsoft 365 org themes within Viva Engage. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with preview and publishing controls for admins.

item.title: MC1447671: Microsoft Entra: Migrate GitHub Actions federated identity credentials to immutable subjects
item.description: GitHub Actions now supports immutable OIDC subject formats with repository and owner IDs to enhance Microsoft Entra federated identity security. Organizations using GitHub Actions OIDC must migrate to this format by late July 2026 to prevent token mismatches and reduce unauthorized access risks.

item.title: RM513278: Planner: Available in Outlook
item.description: Planner in Outlook brings all your tasks, plans, and the new Planner Agent directly into your inbox, so you can manage work where you already work.

item.title: RM522616: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
item.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

item.title: RM547834: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events.

item.title: RM553213: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Council
item.description: Council in Researcher runs multiple leading AI models from different providers in parallel in one place, so you can quickly compare outputs and see consensus vs. conflict) to make high-stakes decisions with greater confidence—without switching tools.

item.title: RM557558: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized Default Mark and Notify Email Template
item.description: Enabling localization for the default Mark and Notify email template used in admin review and automation flows for user reported messages. This ensures end users receive review outcome notifications in their preferred language, improving understanding, trust, and participation in email reporting within Microsoft Defender for Office 365.

item.title: RM558538: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Critique in Researcher
item.description: Responses are generated by GPT and Claude working together, with GPT drafting an initial response and Claude reviewing for increased response accuracy, completeness, and citation integrity.

item.title: RM559989: Outlook: Copilot now provides concise summaries with Outlook search results
item.description: Get answers to queries quickly with Copilot's concise AI summaries at the top of Outlook search results. Users can dig deeper by opening Copilot chat directly from the Copilot summary card.

item.title: RM561032: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
item.description: We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.

item.title: RM561035: Microsoft Edge: Allow M365 authentication popups in work profiles
item.description: When users are signed in with a work account, some Microsoft 365 sites (for example, microsoft.com, cloud.microsoft, and microsoft365.com) may open authentication pop-up windows to Microsoft sign-in endpoints such as login.microsoftonline.com, login.live.com, or login.microsoft.com. These pop-ups are required to complete sign-in. Microsoft Edge now allows authentication pop-up windows from Microsoft first party services by default. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365Au...

item.title: RM561208: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to l...

item.title: RM561488: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.

item.title: RM561652: Microsoft Edge: v.151 - Passkey Sync for Enterprise Users
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing support for passkey synchronization for enterprise users, enabling secure, passwordless authentication across devices. Passkeys created in Edge can now be synced seamlessly, improving sign-in experience while maintaining strong security standards.

item.title: RM562996: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
item.description: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics.

item.title: RM565215: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
item.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app call history. Note: Queues app requires a Teams Premium license.

item.title: RM566856: Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
item.description: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. When issues are detected, PMP will automatically generate actionable alerts and support ticket creation workflows, enabling IT administrators to proactively identify and triage room health issues before they impact meeting experiences.

item.title: RM568079: Outlook: Insert Signature Image from OneDrive
item.description: Users can now insert images into their email signature directly from OneDrive, in addition to the device photo library.

item.title: RM568760: Outlook: Filter Messages by Events
item.description: You can now filter your messages for calendar invitations. Simply go to the filter and select Events from the drop down.

item.title: RM568763: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
item.description: We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. These are additive, user-driven changes — users can collapse the left nav, resize its width, favorite up to 50 communities, and drag to reorder their favorited communities. None of these changes alter which destinations appear in the navigation. These enhancements are applicable to all surfaces that have the Engage left navigation menu - Web, and the Engage...

item.title: RM568785: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
item.description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

item.title: RM568791: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web. This update also introduces Goals in basic plans.

item.title: MC1230892: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Updated handling of entity inserts in the Copilot Chat input box
item.description: Starting mid-August 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat will update entity insertion so entity names no longer appear as text in the input box, creating cleaner prompts. This change is default for all tenants, requires no admin action, and affects all commercial cloud users.

item.title: MC1293479: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: New guided diagnostics experience for DLP
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will introduce a new guided diagnostics experience by October 2026, enhancing visibility into DLP policy evaluation and actions. Eligible tenants get Security Copilot-powered insights for troubleshooting and optimization. Existing policies and enforcement remain unchanged, with no impact on user workflows.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, enabling admins to move inactive SharePoint and OneDrive files to Microsoft 365 Archive. Archived content remains compliant and discoverable but is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, requiring admin configuration.

item.title: MC1269211: Clearer RSVP selection in Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will highlight users' selected RSVP (Yes, Maybe, No) for meetings, improving visibility. Rollout starts mid-September 2026 and completes by mid-October 2026, affecting all iOS and Android users worldwide, GCC, and GCC High tenants. No admin action needed; feature enabled by default.

item.title: MC1423114: Microsoft Teams: Stricter external access controls for federated chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new PowerShell controls by late September 2026 to enforce stricter external access and mutual federation policies in federated group chats. These controls, disabled by default, help admins limit chat participation to approved external users and ensure mutual federation compliance, with automatic removal of non-compliant participants.

item.title: MC1427972: Microsoft SharePoint: Restricted content discovery enhancements for Copilot and Microsoft 365 search
item.description: Microsoft is enhancing SharePoint's Restricted Content Discovery (RCD) to limit content visibility in Copilot and Microsoft 365 search, starting late July 2026. Files on RCD-enabled sites won't appear in AI-powered search or Copilot, and AI entry points will be removed, ensuring better compliance and content control.

item.title: MC1325414: Microsoft Entra ID SSPR will require registered authentication methods starting November 9, 2026
item.description: Starting November 9, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID SSPR will require explicitly registered authentication methods for password reset verification, disallowing directory-sourced contact info unless registered. A registration campaign begins October 5, 2026. Organizations must ensure users register methods to avoid reset failures.

item.title: MC1330891: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 200 breakout rooms per meeting. Rollout begins early July 2026 for Targeted Release and mid-August 2026 for General Availability. No action is required; the feature is enabled by default.

item.title: RM495002: Microsoft Teams: Slash commands for apps
item.description: You can now interact with your favorite apps directly from Teams chat and channels compose box using slash commands. Type / and start interacting with Apps and Agents, invoke workflows and more.

item.title: RM555852: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

item.title: RM559605: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. The new Meeting chats section will replace the Meeting chats filter, that was previously available at t...

item.title: RM560813: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
item.description: Large file sharing in Teams today introduces blocking behavior, forcing users to wait for uploads to complete and disrupting real-time collaboration. To improve productivity and reduce perceived latency, we are introducing asynchronous file uploads. item.title: RM561486: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. item.title: RM566866: Planner: Task Details Side Pane experience

item.title: RM567302: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls

item.title: RM567457: Microsoft Teams: View and manage auto attendant shared voicemails directly in the Queues app
item.description: Calls to an Auto Attendant that are routed to voicemail will now appear directly within Queues app. This enables organizations to manage shared Auto Attendant voicemails in a centralized experience, making it easier for teams to track, triage, and respond to customer messages.

item.title: RM568366: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites

item.title: MC1446807: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android

item.title: MC1446804: SharePoint Pages: Flexible Section Authoring Improvements

item.title: MC1446799: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual meeting recaps support personalized recap translation

item.title: RM566201: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
item.description: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots.
